games.name: Xmas Squad
games.description: Physics co-op comedy for up to 4 players: deliver presents, steal cookies and save your friends from monsters. One more house and we're outta here. Promise.

games.name: Space Crawlers
games.description: Clear out space battlefields using a physics-based grappling hook. Salvage wreckage, recycle it into resources, upgrade your equipment, and grow your salvage business to unlock increasingly lucrative contracts.

games.name: Spray Days
games.description: Paint, restore, and customize worn-out objects in this satisfying spray painting simulator. Complete quirky commissions, upgrade your tools, expand your workshop, and grow your restoration business - solo or with friends in online co-op!

games.name: Radioactivity
games.description: Radioactivity is a co-op survival horror. You are a Liquidator! Together or alone, help your state clean up post-apocalyptic radioactive wilderness. Plan each deployment, fight radiation spread and the creatures that it produces. Together, make WEA flourish once more!

games.name: Needle in a Haystack Simulator in a Haystack of Needle in a Haystack Simulators
games.description: 5,000,000 games on VAPOR, and all but one are clones. From your bedroom PC, screen procedurally generated store pages, stamp each fake on the detail that gives it away, put bots to work, and dig through the haystack for the one original. An incremental hidden object parody.

games.name: Bingolazo
games.description: A colorful bingo roguelite. Pick which balls to call, mark your cards and chain lines, diagonals and full cards into huge scores. Collect lucky charms that bend the rules, play legendary balls like Saturn and beat the club's bosses, in endless runs or the story mode.

games.name: FX WARRIOR
games.description: FX Warrior is a story-driven simulation game blending forex trading with work life. To save enough to move out, choose between part-time jobs and leveraged trading, face market swings and losses exceeding your balance, and reach your own ending!

games.name: A Game About Bees, Flowers and Vacuum
games.description: A first-person petal-gathering game: a million flowers, hundreds of oversized bees and one vacuum. Knock petals loose with your fists, a knife and a bat, vacuum them up, and send the bees out to help. Sell the haul, upgrade your tools and bees, and climb the valley one color at a time.

games.name: The Gigglebone Gang: Pantsylvania
games.description: The Gigglebone Gang returns! In Pantsylvania, everybody's pants are serious business. Join the Gigglebone Gang across ten locales and 50 activities — sing-along songs, hidden-object hunts, silly science and interactive stories — in this fully restored 1995 point-and-click edutainment classic.

games.name: Sort of the Apocalypse
games.description: The world ended. The mess didn’t. Sort over 10,000 scavenged supplies in a cozy first-person organizing game. Transform a cluttered bunker into satisfyingly stocked shelves, earn credits, and unlock upgrades to tackle the mountain of mess.

games.name: Bondoq: Desktop Gunners
games.description: Collect, trade, and build your team of Gunners! Discover heroes with unique weapons and effects, and hunt for rare items. Watch the battles unfold automatically on your desktop!

games.name: Next, Million Worlds
games.description: Expand your civilization to an empire of a million worlds. Balance production and logistics, experiment with economy mods, but don't sweat it. This is the age of expansion; growth is inevitable. This is a relaxed incremental experience where you can optimize and experiment, but you can't lose.

games.name: The King Must Grow
games.description: A physics-based active incremental about a not entirely humble jester with one very important job: Feed cute, entirely innocent slimes to the ever-hungry Slime King. Throw them by hand, then see if you can build systems that do it for you. Just never, ever question the King.

games.name: Tiny Vessel
games.description: A companion idle ARPG that lives beside whatever you are doing. A tiny crew of crash-landed survivors fights along an alien walkway while you work: real loot, a Relay to grow the vessel, depths that demand better gear. Progress keeps going while you are away.

games.name: Festival Fireworks Simulator
games.description: Whenever you want fireworks, the night sky is ready. Click to launch a burst, write a wish across the sky, or build a whole show from the very first shell. Holidays, birthdays and ordinary evenings all deserve a fireworks show.

games.name: Clean 'Em Ocean
games.description: An incremental game about cleaning the ocean with a speedboat, unlocking upgrades, and cleaning more trash. Will you save the ocean?

games.name: Sandcastle Kingdom
games.description: A cozy sandbox for building sandcastles. Shape your island, castles and courtyards with dynamic sand. Dig canals, ponds and fill them with realistic water. Decorate your island. Share your home with cute animal friends, help them with their quests and gather around the campfire as the sun goes down.

games.name: An Eggcellent Sorting Game
games.description: Sort thousands of colorful eggs by matching their patterns in this relaxing organizing game. Turn a giant mess into satisfying order, level up 8 skills, meet quirky characters, and complete quests. No rush, no pressure. Just you and an eggnormous pile of eggs!

games.name: The First Pixel
games.description: In the beginning there is a white screen and one black pixel. Click it, and it wakes. Grow it into pattern, memory and meaning, hunt 100 lost relics across erased worlds, and discover what a pixel sees once it has gathered everything. A quiet, mysterious incremental.

games.name: KIBA - Kittys Idle Brick Arena
games.description: Let it brick! Mix & match 20 unique balls across 14 Active, Passive, and Clicker slots to trigger massive chain reactions. Earn gold, smash bricks, and trigger prestige for permanent upgrades. Play actively or just sit back and progress idle!

games.name: Desktop Arrow Defense
games.description: "Desktop Arrow Defense" is an idle tower defense mini-game that runs on your desktop. It lets you work while watching your tiny archer defend against incoming enemies. Upgrade your character's attributes, collect and enhance equipment, unlock skill combinations, and create your legendary archer!

games.name: Edenfinity
games.description: Edenfinity is a relaxing incremental colony game where you guide Adam and Eve as they build a new civilization in Eden. Gather resources, sell your surplus, craft bricks, construct houses, and unlock upgrades.

games.name: Cash & Stash: A Vaultkeeper Story
games.description: After a failed robbery attempt, the bank has been torn apart and left in complete chaos. Now, as the Vaultkeeper, you must sort through more than 16,000 scattered items, return everything to its proper place, and uncover the stories behind the bank’s clients and their valuables.

games.name: All-in Tide
games.description: Adapt to the ever-changing weather. Learn every cave along the shore. Swing your shovel and dig up whatever the sea has hidden. But never lose sight of your own desires — they can drive you mad, or make you filthy rich.

games.name: Over The Gnome!
games.description: Become a giant gnome-crushing boulder. Chase the treasure gnomes, shrink the giant yetis with your shrink ray, grow and improve until you crush them all. Travel through 5 unique worlds, prestige, and unlock permanent talents to become unstoppable.

games.name: Gas Station Simulator
games.description: A gas station and convenience store tycoon. Stock shelves, pump fuel, and ring up sales. Grow from a humble roadside stall by pricing stock and unlocking licenses to upgrade your shop. Set out every product by hand, tidy up what customers leave behind, and grow a thriving business.

games.name: Grape by Grape
games.description: A cozy vineyard idler where your cursor makes vines grow. Turn 14 grape varieties into aged wine, raisins, vinegar and pekmez; automate six connected estate stations and fill customer orders. No frantic clicking, no failure—just one more harvest, bottle and upgrade.

games.name: Pixel Ping Pong
games.description: A relaxing idle incremental game where you break tiles, earn coins, and upgrade your growing swarm of balls. Aim your shots to speed up your progress, or sit back and let the game play itself.

games.name: Astrobreaker
games.description: Astrobreaker is a short incremental game about making a spaceship faster and more powerful. Mine planets, gather resources, and upgrade your ship.

games.name: ACT OUT
games.description: A chaotic online party game of 3D charades. Grab a floppy puppet, act out your secret word on a live theater stage, and race your friends to guess it before the clock runs out. Push-to-talk voice, custom Workshop maps, and a winner's podium. Best with 3+ friends.

games.name: OnlyCats
games.description: Pet cats, earn love, buy more cats. OnlyCats is a cozy incremental idle game where hovering over adorable pixel cats fills your coin and love stash. Unlock new cats, grow your collection, and discover more upgrades.

games.name: Incremental Garden
games.description: A short incremental game about a magical garden. Grow wonderful flowers, earn money, buy upgrades, and roll the gacha to discover rarer plants! Over 30 unique plants are waiting for you!

games.name: 5-Star Taxi
games.description: A fast-paced arcade taxi game where time is your greatest enemy - find shortcuts, deliver passengers, tear through a destructible city, escape the police, and earn a perfect 5-star rating before your shift ends.

games.name: Over Package!
games.description: Over Package! is a chaotic, physics-based multiplayer party game. Clash with your friends in hilarious arena brawls to deliver cargo. Outsmart rivals with dynamic environmental destruction, leverage chaotic physics, and turn every delivery into absolute combat logistics madness!

games.name: Juicy Fugitives
games.description: Hunt down the most wanted fruits in this cartoon third-person shooter. Play as a pirate crew framed by a mysterious fire, blast through waves of enemies across 5 kingdoms, and survive slapstick boss fights, solo or in 3 player online co-op.

games.name: Winds of Bounty
games.description: Winds of Bounty is a casual, fast-paced single and network multi player, competitive sailing exploration and treasure hunting game, featuring multiple game modes, including Treasure Hunt, Monster Hunt, Orb Hunt, Race, Arena, and Treasure Gallery!

games.name: Black Hole Idle
games.description: Start as a tiny black hole and grow by consuming asteroids, planets, and star systems. Automate your power, unlock upgrades, and devour the universe in this relaxing space idle incremental game.

games.name: TCG Football Card Shop Simulator
games.description: Manage your own football card shop! Open card packs to discover rare football player cards, stock your shelves with football merchandise, sell to customers, expand your store, and build the ultimate football card shop.

games.name: Mini Sushi Factory
games.description: Build your own sushi factory in this cozy automation game. Unlock new ingredients, buy new recipes and upgrade food machinery to feed the Yōkai with food they love.

games.name: Tiny Taxi
games.description: Drift, drive and survive in a top-down pixel art city! Pick up passengers with strange demands, earn cash to upgrade your taxi and choose curses that make every run tougher. Customize your cab/driver, build your mixtape and climb the leaderboard.

games.name: Synapse Idle
games.description: Grow a 3D neural network from a single neuron. Workers haul energy along radiant paths, buildings amplify every passing signal, and a 100-node skill tree reshapes how your synapse evolves. A calm, incremental idle game about watching complexity bloom — tinted in whatever colors you choose.

games.name: Mind The Gap
games.description: Mind The Gap is a puzzle platformer game where you and your unlikely companion work together to create your own path to freedom. Featuring 80+ handcrafted levels, unique bosses, and hidden collectables, each stage introduces new mechanics that push your abilities further.

games.name: Brawling Beetles
games.description: Die. Adapt. Fight Back. In this faced-paced top down multiplayer beetle brawler, every death makes you stronger. Choose between abilites, classes and weapons. Battle in matches with up to 4 players, fight PvE enemies, collect loot, and unleash powerful ultimates to claim victory.

games.name: Kādomon: Incremental Eclipse
games.description: Build a team of Kādomon that fights for you, then push deeper. An Idle Incremental RPG where your creatures auto-battle through endless waves, each with their own skill tree to master. Eclipse your run to unlock permanent power and climb further than ever before.

games.name: Thieving Together
games.description: You and your crew have one goal: break in, grab everything, and get out before sunrise. Thieving Together is a chaotic physics PvP & co-op heist party game. Drag loot, dodge rivals, stack the van fast. Everything wobbles. Everyone steals. Biggest haul by sunrise wins.

games.name: Runemoria - Blades of Memory
games.description: Flip cards, uncover pairs, and command your squad in a tactical memory RPG. Equip weapons, unlock powerful skills, and battle enemies or other players in strategic single-player and PvP combat.

games.name: Lines Must Cross
games.description: Lines Must Cross is an incremental graph game about firing mathematical functions and earning progress when they intersect. Click to spawn lines, unlock new function types, and grow a living coordinate system.

games.name: Hollywood Hustle: A Prop Collector Simulator
games.description: A physics-driven cleanup simulator on an abandoned Hollywood studio. Fantasy epics, sitcoms, sci-fi blockbusters: their props ended up here. Sort it all, ship boxed orders to film sets and beyond, sell the rest, and resurrect the old animatronics to help.

games.name: Mine or Burn
games.description: Start with a basic mining ship and snowball into an asteroid-crushing powerhouse in this incremental bullet hell roguelite. Mine asteroids, battle rival miners, stack upgrades, create powerful builds, and survive escalating threats across dangerous star systems.

games.name: Particle Collectotron
games.description: Click and collect energy in this short, active incremental. Upgrade your reactor, tune injector payload and trajectories, unlock exotic matter, and push the experiment past its limits.

games.name: Catching Breaks
games.description: Catching Breaks is a darkly comedic office simulator where fixing problems is easy and dealing with people is not. Repair broken machines while coworkers interrupt you with pointless conversations, fake urgency, and corporate nonsense. Keep the office running long enough to survive another workday.

games.name: Zombie Industrial Complex
games.description: Exterminate zombies using the might of the military industrial complex. In this active incremental game, you'll earn money by defeating zombies which can be used to buy weapons, purchase upgrades, call in airstrikes, and send in the tanks!

games.name: StoryMode
games.description: StoryMode is a reading tool completely built around idle/incremental gameplay and progression. Add manga and books, earn experience, levels, and rewards as you read. Complete quests, discover companions, and personalize your reading experience with customizable themes and animated backgrounds.

games.name: Pumpkin Is Yummy!?
games.description: Your own little farm village, tucked into the corner of your desktop. Raise a chatty pumpkin, tend your crops, and collect critters in this quirky, lighthearted idler. How you raise your Pumpkin decides who they become.

games.name: Pakku Pony
games.description: Pakku Pony is a 2D virtual pet simulator where you raise your own pony! It’s a chill point-and-click game where you take care of your little garden, cook delicious dishes and relax with fun minigames. Oh, and don’t forget to look stylish with cosmetics and customization options!

games.name: Captain Speedfin
games.description: Captain Speedfin is stuck with an hourglass and needs to be fast! Race against the clock through 60 challenging levels of pirate parkour, where every second counts. Grab your treasure and get out before time runs out!

games.name: CRUSHMINO
games.description: Crushmino is a roguelike drop-action game. Craft your own build and drop blocks to crush your enemies.

games.name: PikiChick
games.description: Little chick needs you! Feed it, cuddle it, dress it up and build a cozy coop full of hens and eggs. Play 7 cheerful mini-games, visit your friends' coops and team up in 4 co-op games with your Steam friends.

games.name: Jiggle Desktop Lab 2D
games.description: Meet your new bouncy desktop companion! Jiggle Desktop 2D brings your screen to life with satisfying, reactive physics. Poke, drag, and play with your interactive virtual pet while you work, browse, or game.

games.name: Not a Bug: Idle Defense
games.description: Not a Bug is a relaxing incremental idle defense game. You can’t lose, since every bug dies the moment it reaches the glitch. Install apps, feed the bugs and watch the chaos. Remember: it’s not a bug, it’s a feature.
